cases.description: In this fictional workshop manual, what washer does the Alder pump use and when must it not be installed?

steps.text: In this fictional workshop manual, what washer does the Alder pump use and when must it not be installed?

contexts.text: Alder pump assembly uses a blue fiber washer, reference code ALD-17. The matching washer is described in the workshop maintenance inventory. Before fitting it, read the Alder pump exceptions page; color alone is not approval.
contexts.title: Alder pump procedure

contexts.text: The blue ALD-17 washer must not be installed if the seat is cracked. Stop assembly and replace the cracked seat. This warning applies even if the washer fits.
contexts.title: Alder pump exceptions

rubric: Read both procedure and exception; ALD-17 blue fiber washer, no installation in cracked seat; do not replace conditional warning with unconditional assembly.

cases.description: For the fictional wind-up Clockwork hatch, what spring setting applies to type B and what must be checked first?

steps.text: For the fictional wind-up Clockwork hatch, what spring setting applies to type B and what must be checked first?

contexts.text: Clockwork hatch settings table. Columns: hatch type, spring notch, prerequisite. Type A: notch 2, dry pivot. Type B: notch 4, dry pivot. Footnote: If the pivot is wet, do not wind either type; dry and inspect the pivot first. Numbers are spring notches, not turns.
contexts.title: Clockwork hatch settings

rubric: Type B notch4 (not four turns); dry pivot prerequisite, wet pivot no winding; retain table units and footnote.

cases.description: Find the maintenance interval for fictional part VT-204 and identify the relevant equipment.

steps.text: Find the maintenance interval for fictional part VT-204 and identify the relevant equipment.

contexts.text: Part VT-204 is the pawl used in the Vale hand crank. Its maintenance interval is recorded under the crank service schedule rather than this inventory.
contexts.title: Vale inventory

contexts.text: Vale hand crank pawl inspection occurs every twelve operating hours. It is operating hours, not twelve calendar hours. Replace a pawl with a cracked tooth immediately, regardless of interval.
contexts.title: Vale crank service schedule

rubric: Identify Vale hand crank pawl; twelve operating hours, immediate cracked-tooth exception; read schedule, not just inventory.

cases.description: For the fictional Cedar press, which pin is specified and does the instruction apply to a split frame?

steps.text: For the fictional Cedar press, which pin is specified and does the instruction apply to a split frame?

contexts.text: The Cedar press uses pin CP-8 only in an intact frame. A split frame must be replaced before the pin is installed; pin replacement alone does not repair the frame.
contexts.title: Cedar press manual

rubric: CP-8; frame replacement first if split; no unconditional pin repair.
